verdicts.reason: The two candidates are almost the same layout. Each puts the pen row up top and the 'STATIONERY SALE' headline below it, with a big empty red gap between them and a lot of dead space at the top and bottom. Each also leaves the original's trailing pencil orphaned in the bottom-left corner, cut off from everything else. A sits a few pixels lower and is slightly better centred; B sits slightly higher. Neither difference matters, so they rank the same.
